DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は広場に日がよく当たっています。散歩でしたら、休憩所の場所もご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The square gets plenty of sun today. If you are taking a walk, I can show you the rest area too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昼休みに少し歩こうと思いましたが、思ったより暑いです。長く歩かず、日陰で休める範囲を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼休みに歩くつもりだが暑いので日陰で休める短い範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I would walk a little on my lunch break, but it is hotter than expected. Please show me a short area where I can rest in shade without walking long.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you planned a lunchtime walk but ask for a short area with shaded rests because it is hot. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この入口から左へ進むと屋根のある休憩所があります。そこを起点に木陰を往復する短い道を選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a covered rest area to the left from this entrance. You can start there and choose a short path back and forth under the trees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先に休憩所へ行ってから歩くんですね。地図では広場の向こうにも道がありますが、そちらは日陰が続きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 休憩所を起点にすると理解し広場向こうの道も日陰が続くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I go to the rest area first, then walk. The map shows a path beyond the square too; does shade continue there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the rest area is the starting point and ask whether the path beyond the square remains shaded. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 広場を横切る部分は日なたです。今日はそこまで行かず、休憩所の周りの道で戻るほうがご希望に合いそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The stretch crossing the square is sunny. Staying on paths around the rest area instead of going that far seems closer to your wishes today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では広場は横切りません。休憩所には椅子がありますか。足が疲れたら座ってから戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 広場を横切らず足が疲れたら休憩所で座れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not cross the square. Are there chairs at the rest area? If my legs get tired, I want to sit before returning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid crossing the square and ask whether you can sit at the rest area if your legs tire. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 椅子があります。風通しのよい側を選んで休めますが、休憩所まで戻るのもつらくなったら無理をせず近くの職員に声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are chairs. You can rest on a well-ventilated side, but if even returning to the rest area becomes difficult, do not push yourself; speak to a nearby staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水も持っているので、そこで休みます。職場へ戻るときは、どの門がこの入口につながっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水を持参し休憩所で休むとして職場へ戻る入口につながる門を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I brought water too, so I will rest there. When returning to work, which gate connects to this entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you brought water and will rest there, and ask which gate connects to the entrance for returning to work. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩所の左側に見える小さな門が、今いらした入口です。大きな門のほうへ行くと広場を通ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The small gate visible to the left of the rest area is the entrance you came through. Going toward the large gate takes you across the square.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さな門を覚えておきます。まず屋根の下で休んでから、体調を見て木陰を少し歩き、小さな門から戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小さい門を覚え先に屋根下で休み体調を見て木陰を少し歩いて戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will remember the small gate. First I will rest under the roof, then walk a little in tree shade if I feel well and return through the small gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Remember the small gate, rest under cover first, then walk briefly in shade according to your condition and return. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 短い散歩でも体調を優先してください。ご案内は以上です。いってらっしゃい、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Prioritize how you feel even on a short walk. That is all the guidance. Enjoy your walk and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お迎えでしょうか。到着列車のことで何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you meeting someone? Is there a problem with an arriving train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母が十時二十分の列車で来ます。杖を使っていて歩くのが遅いので、ホームからの道を先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十時二十分着の母が杖でゆっくり歩くためホームからの経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother is coming on the 10:20 train. She uses a cane and walks slowly, so I want to know the route from the platform beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the platform route for your mother arriving at 10:20, who uses a cane and walks slowly. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その列車は一番ホームに着きます。改札までは階段を使わない通路がありますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That train arrives at platform 1. There is a route to the ticket gate without stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 階段がないなら助かります。母は駅の外で私を探すつもりですが、途中で休める椅子はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 階段なしと確認し母が休める椅子を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: No stairs would help. My mother plans to find me outside the station; are there chairs to rest along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the stair-free route and ask about chairs where your mother can rest. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一番ホームに椅子があります。改札を出た先にも待合室がありますので、そこで合流してはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are chairs on platform 1. There is also a waiting room beyond the ticket gate; why not meet there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では待合室で待ちます。母が通路を間違えないよう、降りたときに案内してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待合室で待つと伝え降車時の道案内を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will wait in the waiting room. Can someone guide her when she gets off so she does not take the wrong passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wait in the waiting room and ask about guidance when she gets off. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 到着時のご案内について係員に伝えます。お母様が降りる車両と、お名前はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell an attendant about arrival guidance. Do you know which car she is in and her name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二両目に乗っていて、名前は山本です。青い上着を着ています。階段のない通路を教えていただければ大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二両目、山本、青い上着と案内に必要な情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: She is in the second car, and her name is Yamamoto. She is wearing a blue jacket. Showing her the stair-free passage will be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the necessary guidance details: second car, Yamamoto, blue jacket. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二両目の山本様ですね。その内容で係員に伝えます。お母様にも、改札の先の待合室で合流するとお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ms. Yamamoto in the second car. I will tell the attendant that. Tell your mother too that you will meet in the waiting room beyond the gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 母に電話して待合室へ来るよう伝えます。急がなくていいことも伝えて、私はそこで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 母へ待合室での合流と急がなくてよいことを連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will call her to come to the waiting room. I will tell her there is no need to hurry and wait there myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your mother about meeting in the waiting room and not needing to hurry. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。到着に合わせて係員が確認します。それでは、待合室でお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. An attendant will check in time for arrival. Please wait in the waiting room. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族の転入手続きのご相談ですか。どなたがお引っ越しされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about moving-in procedures for your family? Who has moved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と妻です。私は昨日から新しい家に住んでいますが、妻は来月来ます。一緒に届出したいんですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人は昨日入居し妻は来月来るため一緒に届出できるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My wife and I. I have lived in the new home since yesterday, but she comes next month. I would like to file together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about filing together when you moved in yesterday and your wife comes next month. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人が住み始める時期は違うのですね。奥様もすでにこちらへ転入したという内容では、扱えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You start living here at different times. We cannot treat the application as if your wife has already moved in too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 妻はまだ前の家で仕事をしています。今日は私の分だけ相談して、妻の分は来月に分けるということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 妻が前の家で働いており本人分から相談するか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: She is still working at our previous home. Does that mean I discuss only my part today and separate hers for next month?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your wife is working at the previous home and confirm starting with your own case. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、まずご本人の今の状況を担当窓口で確認しましょう。奥様の予定についても、その際に相談していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. First confirm your present circumstances at the responsible counter. You can also discuss your wife's plans then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。持ってきた転出の書類には二人の名前が載っています。このまま持っていってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転出書類に二人の名前が載っているまま持参できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. The moving-out documents I brought have both names. May I take them as they are?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may bring moving-out documents showing both names. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その書類も担当者にお見せください。二人の名前が載っていることと、実際の入居日は別々であることを説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show those documents to the staff member too. Explain both names are listed but the actual move-in dates differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、妻がまだ住んでいないことを最初に伝えます。今日書く用紙に、妻の入居予定日まで書く必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 妻は未入居と伝える意向と入居予定日の記入要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will first say she does not live here yet. On today's form, do I also need to write her planned move-in date?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will explain your wife has not moved in and ask whether her planned date must be entered. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ確定していない予定を入居済みの日としては書かず、記入箇所は担当者に確認してください。用紙はこちらでお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not write an uncertain plan as a completed move-in date. Ask the staff member which fields to complete. We will give you the form here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 用紙と二人の名前がある書類を持って、私の昨日の入居と妻の来月の予定を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙と書類を持参し本人の実際の入居と妻の予定を区別して説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the form and documents with both names and explain my actual move yesterday separately from her plan for next month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bring the form and documents and distinguish your actual move from your wife's plan. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その内容で担当窓口へご相談ください。三番窓口をご案内します。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, discuss those details with the responsible counter. I will direct you to counter 3. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の日時を変更されたいとのことですね。診察券番号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to change your appointment date and time. Please give me your patient card number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三二六八です。来週水曜日の耳鼻科の予約を、仕事の都合で別の日にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察券番号三二六八と水曜予約の変更希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: 3268. I want to change next Wednesday's ear, nose and throat appointment to another day because of work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give patient number 3268 and request a change to Wednesday's appointment. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三二六八番のご予約は、水曜日十時の内科になっています。耳鼻科のおつもりでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The reservation for 3268 is internal medicine at 10 on Wednesday. Did you think it was ear, nose and throat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですか。紹介状をもらったあとに予約したんですが、私が科の名前を勘違いしたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紹介状で予約したが科名を勘違いした可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I booked after receiving a referral, but I may have misunderstood the department name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you booked with a referral but may have mistaken the department. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約記録には、紹介状を持参して内科を受診する予定とあります。紹介状の宛先もご確認いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The record says you will bring a referral and attend internal medicine. Could you check the referral's addressee too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手元の紹介状には内科と書いてあります。耳の症状の話をしていたので、耳鼻科だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紹介状の内科表記と耳鼻科と思った理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The referral here says internal medicine. We had talked about ear symptoms, so I thought it was ear, nose and throat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the internal medicine wording and why you thought it was ear, nose and throat. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、内科の予約として日時の変更を伺います。金曜日の十一時でしたら空きがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then we will change the date and time of the internal medicine appointment. Friday at 11 is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金曜日の十一時なら行けます。診療科は内科のままで、紹介状もそのまま持っていくんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金曜十一時を選び内科と紹介状が変わらないことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can come Friday at 11. The department stays internal medicine, and I bring the same referral, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose Friday at 11 and confirm the department and referral remain unchanged. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、内科の予約日時だけを変更します。紹介状もお持ちください。受付に変更後の日時を伝えていただければ結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we change only the internal medicine appointment time. Bring the referral too. Just tell reception the new date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 内科の金曜日十一時でお願いします。予定表にも科の名前を書き足して、紹介状を忘れずに持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内科金曜十一時で確定し予定表に科名を追記して紹介状を持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please make it internal medicine, Friday at 11. I will add the department to my planner and remember the referral.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm internal medicine Friday at 11, add the department to your planner, and bring the referral. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 金曜日十一時に変更しました。水曜日の予約は取り消しています。それでは、当日は受付へお越しください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: It is changed to Friday at 11. Wednesday's appointment is canceled. Please come to reception that day. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の件でご相談ですね。なくなった状況から教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are consulting about a bicycle. Please explain how it disappeared.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、店の駐輪場に停めた自転車がなくなりました。今朝ネットで、よく似たものが売られているのを見ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の駐輪場での紛失と今朝見た似た販売写真を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday, my bicycle disappeared from a shop's parking area. This morning online I saw a very similar one for sale.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain yesterday's disappearance from the parking area and this morning's similar sale photo. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: よく似ていても、写真だけで同じ自転車とは判断できません。車体を区別できる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even if similar, a photo alone cannot establish it is the same bicycle. Are there distinguishing features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 銀色の車体で、後ろの泥よけに赤い星のシールを貼っています。販売写真にも赤いものが写っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 銀色車体と後ろ泥よけの赤い星シールを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: A silver frame and a red star sticker on the rear mudguard. Something red appeared in the sale photo too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the silver frame and red star sticker on the rear mudguard. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: シールの形まで確認できる写真でしょうか。ご自身の自転車の写真や防犯登録の控えもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is the photo clear enough to identify the sticker shape? Do you also have your own bicycle photo and registration copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 販売写真はぼやけていますが、自分の自転車の写真と登録の控えは家にあります。売り手に会って確かめてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 販売写真が不鮮明と伝え自分の写真と登録控えがあり売り手へ会ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The sale photo is blurry, but my own photo and registration copy are at home. May I meet the seller to check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the sale photo is unclear, you have your own photo and registration, and ask about meeting the seller. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身で相手に会って取り返そうとせず、まず保存した情報をこちらへお示しください。販売ページの場所と写真を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not meet them yourself to try to recover it. First show us the saved information. We will check the sale page location and photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 直接会うのはやめます。ページが消えた場合に備えて、画面とページのアドレスを残しておけばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 直接会うのをやめページ消失に備え画面とアドレスを残すか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not meet them directly. Should I save the screen and page address in case the page disappears?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid meeting directly and ask about saving the screen and address in case the page disappears. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、掲載内容と見た日時がわかるよう保存してください。車体の写真と登録の控えもお持ちいただければ、詳しく伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, save it so the listing and the date and time seen are clear. Bring your bicycle photo and registration copy too so we can hear more details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日見た時刻も書いて保存します。家の写真と登録の控えをそろえて、改めて相談に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見た時刻とページを保存し車体写真と登録控えをそろえて再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will record today's viewing time and save it. I will gather the photo and registration at home and come to consult again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Save the page and viewing time, gather your bicycle photo and registration, and return to consult. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご自身のものかは、情報を確認してからになります。それでは、資料をそろえてお持ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Whether it is yours can only be determined after checking the information. Please bring the materials together. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その封筒をお送りになりますか。送り方のご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending that envelope? Do you have a preferred shipping method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大切な書類なので、届いたか確認できる方法にしたいです。この封筒だと中の文字も透けてしまうんですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 到着を確認したい書類と透ける封筒の問題を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: They are important documents, so I want a way to check arrival. But the writing inside also shows through this envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the need to confirm document arrival and the see-through envelope problem. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達状況を追跡できる送り方をご案内できます。ただ、送り方を変えても封筒の中身が見えなくなるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can explain tracked shipping. However, changing the shipping method does not make the envelope's contents invisible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 追跡と、中身が透けないことは別なんですね。内側に白い紙を入れるだけでもいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追跡と透け防止の違いを理解し内側の白紙で対処できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So tracking and preventing show-through are separate. Would putting white paper inside be enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand tracking and opacity differ and ask whether white paper inside can help. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外から文字が読めるか、ご自身で確認してください。透けにくい封筒へ入れ替える方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check yourself whether the writing is readable outside. You can also change to an envelope that is less transparent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書類には口座番号が載っているので、封筒を替えたいです。ここで厚手の普通の封筒を買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 口座番号があるため厚手封筒へ替えたいと伝え窓口で買えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The documents show an account number, so I want to replace the envelope. Can I buy a thick ordinary envelope here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the account number makes you want a thicker envelope and ask whether the counter sells one. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この窓口には、今お求めの厚手の封筒はありません。別の場所でご用意いただくことになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: This counter does not have the thick envelope you want now. You will need to obtain it elsewhere.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら文具店で買ってきます。封筒を替えたあとでも、追跡付きの送り方を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 文具店で用意し封筒変更後も追跡付き方法を相談できるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will buy one at a stationery shop. Can I still consult about tracked shipping after changing envelopes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare one at a stationery shop and ask about tracked shipping after replacement. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、封筒をご用意してからお持ちください。大きさと重さを確認して、ご希望に合う方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, bring it once the envelope is ready. We will check size and weight and suggest a method meeting your wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はまだ差し出さずに持ち帰ります。中の文字が読めない封筒に入れ直して、送り方を相談しに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は差し出さず透けない封筒へ替えて再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take it home without posting today. I will put it in an envelope whose contents cannot be read and come to discuss shipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not post today; replace the transparent envelope and return to consult. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類をお返ししますので、お忘れなくお持ちください。それでは、またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will return the documents; please remember to take them. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい口座は、どのような目的でお使いになるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: For what purpose do you plan to use the new account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夫婦の生活費をまとめたいです。私と妻の二人の名前を、一つの口座名義にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夫婦の生活費用に二人名義の口座を作れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: We want to combine our household expenses. Can my wife and I put both names on one account?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can open a two-name account for household expenses. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当店で今ご案内している個人口座は、お一人の名義でお申し込みいただくものです。お二人の連名では受け付けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The personal account currently offered at this branch is applied for in one person's name. We do not accept joint names.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この口座は一人名義なんですね。私の名前で申し込むのを、妻に頼むことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人名義と確認し自分名義の申込みを妻に頼めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So this account is in one name. Can I ask my wife to apply in my name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm one name and ask whether your wife can apply for your account. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の口座を作る場合は、ご本人の意思を確認してお手続きします。奥様がご本人に代わって自由に申し込めるという扱いではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: To make your account, we confirm your own intention during the procedure. It is not treated as your wife being free to apply instead of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。妻の名前で作るなら、妻自身も相談に来る必要があるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 妻名義なら妻本人の相談が必要か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. If it is in her name, does she also need to come for advice herself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm your wife needs her own consultation for an account in her name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 奥様の名義での申込みについては、奥様ご本人に必要書類や手続きをご案内します。まずどなたの口座を使うか相談されてはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: For her application, we explain the documents and procedure to her personally. Why not first discuss whose account to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ二人で決めていません。どちらの名義にするか決める前に、家で読める案内をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名義未決定なので家で読める個人口座案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: We have not decided together yet. Before choosing the name, may I have guidance to read at home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the name is undecided and request personal account information for home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが個人口座の案内です。必要書類はお申し込みになる方の状況を伺って確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the personal account guidance. Required documents are checked after hearing the applicant's circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は申込みをせず、案内を持ち帰ります。妻と名義を決めてから、本人が必要書類を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は申込まず夫婦で名義を決め本人が書類を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the guidance home without applying today. After deciding the name with my wife, that person will ask about required documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not apply today; decide the name together and have the applicant ask about documents. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。疑問が残りましたら、お申し込みになる方から窓口へお尋ねください。それでは、またのご相談をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. If questions remain, have the applicant ask at the counter. We look forward to helping you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切り身の値段をご確認でしょうか。ラベルをご一緒に見ましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the fillet price? Shall we look at the label together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚には二百円とあるのに、このパックには六百円と書いてあります。値札が違っているんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚二百円とパック六百円の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shelf says 200 yen, but this pack says 600 yen. Is the price label wrong?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the difference between the 200-yen shelf label and 600-yen pack. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 棚の二百円は百グラム当たりのお値段です。このパックは三百グラムなので、六百円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The shelf's 200 yen is per 100 grams. This pack is 300 grams, so it is 600 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 百グラム当たりなんですね。一パックが二百円だと思っていました。二人分なので、もう少し少ないものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 百グラム単価と理解し二人用に少量パックを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Per 100 grams, I see. I thought 200 yen was one pack. It is for two people; is there a smaller amount?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the per-100-gram price and ask for a smaller pack for two people. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは二百グラム入りで四百円です。同じ切り身で、値段の計算も同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one is 200 grams for 400 yen. The same fillets and the same price calculation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二百グラムの方にします。この四百円は、レジで税金が足される前の金額ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二百グラムを選び四百円が税込みか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take the 200 grams. Is this 400 yen before tax is added at checkout?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose 200 grams and confirm whether 400 yen includes tax. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この売場のラベルは税込み表示です。こちらのパックは、税込み四百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Labels in this section include tax. This pack is 400 yen including tax.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では四百円ですね。ラベルにある日付は、値引きが始まる日ではなく、使う期限の表示ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日付が値引き開始日か消費期限か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: So 400 yen. Is the date on the label a use-by date rather than the date discounts start?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the date is a discount start or use-by date. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 『消費期限』とある日付です。保存方法もラベルで確認してください。値引きの開始日ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is the date marked ‘use by.’ Check the storage instructions too. It is not a discount start date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保存方法も見て、今日の夕飯に使います。三百グラムの方を戻して、二百グラム入りを一パック買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保存方法を確認して今日使い大きいパックを戻し二百グラム一パックを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check storage and use it for dinner today. I will return the 300-gram pack and buy one 200-gram pack.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check storage, use today, return the large pack, and select one 200-gram pack. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらが税込み四百円のパックです。それでは、レジへお持ちください。お買い物ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, this is the 400-yen tax-included pack. Please take it to checkout. Thank you for shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのベンチは塗装中です。休憩場所をお探しでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: That bench is being painted. Were you looking for somewhere to rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、少し歩いたら座りたいんですが、テープが巻いてありますね。ほかに使えるベンチはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 塗装中のベンチを確認し散歩後に座れる別のベンチを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I want to sit after walking a little, but it is taped off. Are there other usable benches?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Note the bench being painted and ask for another bench to sit after walking. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 噴水の右側のベンチは使えます。この広場から百メートルほど先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The benches on the right of the fountain are available. About 100 meters ahead from this square.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 百メートルなら行けそうです。噴水へ行く途中にも、このベンチのように使えない所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 百メートル先へ行けそうと伝え途中の立入不可箇所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think I can manage 100 meters. Are there inaccessible areas like this bench on the way to the fountain too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say 100 meters seems manageable and ask about closed-off places on the way. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 広場から噴水までの通路は通れます。テープを張った作業場所には入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The path from the square to the fountain is open. Do not enter work areas marked with tape.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通路だけを歩きます。噴水で休んだあと、一周すると出口までどのくらいありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路を歩くと伝え噴水から周回した場合の残り距離を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will walk only on the path. After resting at the fountain, how far is the exit if I continue around the loop?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stay on the path and ask the remaining distance if continuing the loop from the fountain. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一周を続けると、出口までさらに六百メートルほどあります。短く済ませるなら、来た道を戻れますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Continuing the loop is about another 600 meters to the exit. To keep it short, you can retrace your path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一周せず、来た道で戻りたいです。噴水からこの広場へ戻れば、入口も同じ方角ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周回せず来た道で戻ると決め広場と入口の関係を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I will return the same way instead of going around. If I return from the fountain to this square, is the entrance in the same direction?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose to retrace rather than loop and confirm the square's relation to the entrance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、広場の時計の先が入口です。噴水から戻ると時計が正面に見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the entrance is beyond the square's clock. Returning from the fountain, you will see the clock straight ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 噴水のベンチで休んで、時計を見ながら広場へ戻ります。塗装中のベンチには座らず、今日は短く歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 噴水で休み時計を目印に戻り塗装中ベンチを避ける計画を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rest on the fountain bench and return to the square using the clock as a guide. I will not sit on the painted bench and will keep today's walk short.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Rest at the fountain, return using the clock, and avoid the bench being painted. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その道でしたら休憩を挟んで戻れます。作業場所のテープにはお気をつけください。それでは、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That route lets you rest before returning. Be careful around work-area tape. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 行き先がお決まりでしたら、バスの乗り場をご案内します。どちらまでですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: If you know your destination, I can show the bus stop. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宿から南浜で降りると聞きました。乗り場の表示には南浜口とありますが、同じ所でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宿から聞いた南浜と表示の南浜口が同じ停留所か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My lodging told me to get off at Minamihama. The boarding sign says Minamihamaguchi. Are they the same place?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether Minamihama, named by the lodging, and Minamihamaguchi on the sign are the same stop. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内では別の停留所です。宿の名前か、場所が分かるものを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this guide they are different stops. Can you show the lodging name or something showing its location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約メールに宿の地図があります。小さな港の隣で、宿の名前は浜風荘です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約メールの地図を見せ、港の隣の浜風荘へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The booking email has a map. It is beside a small harbor and is called Hamakazeso.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the booking email map and say you are going to Hamakazeso beside the harbor. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地図を拝見すると、こちらの南浜停留所が近いですね。南浜口へ行くバスでは通りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Looking at the map, Minamihama stop here is nearby. Buses to Minamihamaguchi do not pass it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表示が似ていても違うバスなんですね。南浜へ行く便を、乗る前にどう見分ければいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別のバスだと理解し、南浜へ行く便の表示を乗車前に確認する方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So similar signs mean different buses. How can I identify the bus to Minamihama before boarding?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand they are different buses and ask how to check the Minamihama service display before boarding. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 前の行き先表示で南浜経由とあるか確かめてください。二番乗り場から出ます。表示が分からなければ、運転手にも行き先を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the front destination display says ‘via Minamihama.’ It leaves from stop 2. If the display is unclear, tell the driver your destination too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二番乗り場で南浜経由を確認します。降りる停留所も不安なので、宿の地図を運転手に見せておいていいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二番乗り場と経由表示を確認し、宿の地図を運転手へ見せてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check ‘via Minamihama’ at stop 2. I am unsure of the stop to get off, so may I show the lodging map to the driver beforehand?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm stop 2 and the via display, and ask about showing the lodging map to the driver. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発車前に短く相談するとよいと思います。走っている間に運転手へ画面を見せようとするのは避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: A brief discussion before departure would be good. Avoid trying to show the driver a screen while the bus is moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発車前に南浜で降りたいと伝えて、地図を見せます。南浜口という名前だけで乗らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発車前に降車停留所と地図を伝え、似た名称だけで乗らないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Before departure I will say I want to get off at Minamihama and show the map. I will not board just from the name Minamihamaguchi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the stop and map before departure and explain you will not board based only on the similar name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、よく確認できましたね。道中お気を付けて。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, you have checked carefully. Take care on the way. Have a good trip.
